# Event reference (schema v2)

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask events` from events.json. Do not edit by
     hand: CI runs `cargo xtask events --check`. -->

Every event, per contract, from [events.json](../events.json). Design,
conventions and migration notes: [events.md](events.md).

Topics are listed in order. Data is a struct, encoded as an `ScMap` keyed
by field name.

## Shared framework events

Emitted by every contract that lists them under `shared_events` (zenith-common's migration and upgrade frameworks).

| Event | Topics | Data | State change |
|---|---|---|---|
| `schema_migrated` | `"schema_migrated"`, `2u32` | `from: u32`<br>`to: u32` | A migration step finished: the stored schema version is now `to`. |
| `migration_progress` | `"migration_progress"`, `2u32` | `step: u32`<br>`target: u32`<br>`cursor: u32` | A paginated step stopped at `cursor`: the migration is in progress (state-changing entrypoints are closed) until `migrate_batch` finishes it. |
| `upgrade_multisig_pinned` | `"upgrade_multisig_pinned"`, `2u32` | `multisig: address` | The multisig trusted by `upgrade_via_multisig` / `migrate_via_multisig` is now `multisig`. |
| `upgrade_proposed` | `"upgrade_proposed"`, `2u32`, `wasm_hash: bytes32` | `wasm_hash: bytes32`<br>`not_before: u64`<br>`emergency: bool` | `wasm_hash` is allowlisted and installable from `not_before`. |
| `upgrade_cancelled` | `"upgrade_cancelled"`, `2u32`, `wasm_hash: bytes32` | `wasm_hash: bytes32` | `wasm_hash` was removed from the allowlist without being installed. |
| `upgraded` | `"upgraded"`, `2u32`, `wasm_hash: bytes32` | `wasm_hash: bytes32`<br>`schema_version: u32` | The contract now runs `wasm_hash` (its allowlist entry is consumed). The post-upgrade guard is up: user-facing entrypoints are closed until `upgrade_checked`. |
| `upgrade_checked` | `"upgrade_checked"`, `2u32`, `wasm_hash: bytes32` | `wasm_hash: bytes32`<br>`schema_version: u32` | The post-upgrade self-check passed on `wasm_hash`: the guard is down and entrypoints are open. |
| `upgrade_check_failed` | `"upgrade_check_failed"`, `2u32`, `wasm_hash: bytes32` | `wasm_hash: bytes32`<br>`reason: u32` | The post-upgrade self-check failed with error `reason`: the guard stays up (the contract is effectively paused) until a later check passes or another wasm is installed. |

## governor

Also emits: `schema_migrated`, `migration_progress`.

| Event | Topics | Data | State change |
|---|---|---|---|
| `initialized` | `"initialized"`, `2u32` | `token: address`<br>`timelock: address`<br>`voting_delay: u32`<br>`voting_period: u32`<br>`quorum_bps: u32`<br>`proposal_threshold: i128`<br>`schema_version: u32` | The governor is live with these parameters; `timelock` executes passed proposals. Each parameter is also announced by a `param_set`. |
| `proposal_created` | `"proposal_created"`, `2u32`, `id: bytes32` | `proposer: address`<br>`targets: vec<address>`<br>`fns: vec<symbol>`<br>`args: vec<vec<val>>`<br>`description_hash: bytes32`<br>`snapshot: u32`<br>`deadline: u32` | Creates proposal `id` (state `Pending`) with these actions. Voting opens on the ledger after `snapshot` (`Active`) and closes after `deadline`; at that point it is `Succeeded` if for + abstain >= quorum(snapshot) and for > against, else `Defeated`. These transitions follow from ledger progression and have no event. |
| `vote_cast` | `"vote_cast"`, `2u32`, `id: bytes32`, `voter: address` | `support: u32`<br>`weight: i128`<br>`for_votes: i128`<br>`against_votes: i128`<br>`abstain_votes: i128` | `voter` voted `support` (0 Against, 1 For, 2 Abstain) with `weight` (their power at the snapshot). The proposal's tallies are now `for_votes` / `against_votes` / `abstain_votes`. |
| `proposal_queued` | `"proposal_queued"`, `2u32`, `id: bytes32` | `eta: u64`<br>`quorum: i128` | Proposal `id` moves from `Succeeded` to `Queued`: the timelock can execute it from `eta` until its grace period ends (then `Expired`). `Executed` is the timelock's own event. |
| `proposal_canceled` | `"proposal_canceled"`, `2u32`, `id: bytes32` | `caller: address`<br>`was_queued: bool` | Proposal `id` moves to `Canceled`. If `was_queued`, its timelock operation was cancelled too. |
| `param_set` | `"param_set"`, `2u32`, `name: symbol` | `value: i128` | Governance parameter `name` (`voting_delay`, `voting_period`, `quorum_bps` or `proposal_threshold`) is now `value`. |

## grants_escrow

Also emits: `schema_migrated`, `migration_progress`.

| Event | Topics | Data | State change |
|---|---|---|---|
| `grant_created` | `"grant_created"`, `2u32`, `grant_id: u64` | `funder: address`<br>`grantee: address`<br>`token: address`<br>`total: i128`<br>`reviewers: vec<address>`<br>`quorum: u32`<br>`amounts: vec<i128>`<br>`deadlines: vec<u64>`<br>`created_at: u64` | Creates grant `grant_id`, funded with `total` of `token` pulled from `funder`. Milestone `i` is `Pending` with amount `amounts[i]`, deadline `deadlines[i]` and no approvals. |
| `milestone_submitted` | `"milestone_submitted"`, `2u32`, `grant_id: u64`, `idx: u32` | `evidence_hash: bytes32`<br>`submitted_at: u64` | Milestone `idx` moves from `Pending` to `Submitted` with `evidence_hash`. |
| `milestone_approved` | `"milestone_approved"`, `2u32`, `grant_id: u64`, `idx: u32` | `reviewer: address`<br>`approvals: u32`<br>`quorum: u32` | `reviewer` approved milestone `idx`; it now has `approvals` of `quorum`. Reaching quorum is followed by `milestone_released` in the same call. |
| `milestone_released` | `"milestone_released"`, `2u32`, `grant_id: u64`, `idx: u32` | `grantee: address`<br>`amount: i128` | Milestone `idx` moves to `Released`: `amount` was paid to `grantee`. |
| `funds_reclaimed` | `"funds_reclaimed"`, `2u32`, `grant_id: u64` | `funder: address`<br>`amount: i128`<br>`milestones: vec<u32>` | Every milestone index in `milestones` moves to `Reclaimed`; their sum, `amount`, was returned to `funder`. |

## lp_pool

| Event | Topics | Data | State change |
|---|---|---|---|
| `initialized` | `"initialized"`, `2u32` | `admin: address`<br>`keeper: address`<br>`asset: address`<br>`market: address`<br>`max_utilization_bps: u32` | The pool is live at epoch 0 with no assets: `admin` governs, `keeper` writes options into `market` with `asset` collateral, up to `max_utilization_bps`. |
| `keeper_set` | `"keeper_set"`, `2u32` | `keeper: address` | The keeper is now `keeper`. |
| `max_utilization_set` | `"max_utilization_set"`, `2u32` | `max_utilization_bps: u32` | The pool-wide utilization cap is now `max_utilization_bps`. |
| `series_cap_set` | `"series_cap_set"`, `2u32`, `series_id: u64` | `max_collateral: i128` | Series `series_id` may hold up to `max_collateral` of the pool's collateral; zero de-lists it. |
| `liabilities_marked` | `"liabilities_marked"`, `2u32` | `expected_liabilities: i128` | The keeper's mark of open-position liabilities (informational, for `share_price`) is now `expected_liabilities`. Reset to zero, without an event, when the last position is reclaimed. |
| `deposit_queued` | `"deposit_queued"`, `2u32`, `user: address`, `epoch: u32` | `amount: i128`<br>`ticket: i128`<br>`pending_deposits: i128` | `user` queued `amount` for conversion when `epoch` is processed; their ticket for that epoch is now `ticket` and the epoch's pending deposits `pending_deposits`. |
| `withdraw_queued` | `"withdraw_queued"`, `2u32`, `user: address`, `epoch: u32` | `shares: i128`<br>`ticket: i128`<br>`share_balance: i128`<br>`pending_withdraw_shares: i128` | `shares` left `user`'s balance (now `share_balance`) and are queued for redemption at `epoch`'s price; their ticket is now `ticket`, the epoch's pending shares `pending_withdraw_shares`. |
| `claimed` | `"claimed"`, `2u32`, `user: address` | `shares: i128`<br>`assets: i128`<br>`share_balance: i128` | `user`'s tickets from processed epochs settled: `shares` credited (balance now `share_balance`) and `assets` paid out. Settled tickets are removed. |
| `option_written` | `"option_written"`, `2u32`, `series_id: u64`, `position_id: u64` | `collateral: i128`<br>`premium: i128`<br>`idle: i128`<br>`locked: i128` | The pool wrote position `position_id` in `series_id`, locking `collateral` and receiving `premium`. Pool `idle` and `locked` are now as given. |
| `collateral_reclaimed` | `"collateral_reclaimed"`, `2u32`, `position_id: u64` | `series_id: u64`<br>`collateral: i128`<br>`returned: i128`<br>`idle: i128`<br>`locked: i128` | Position `position_id` settled: `returned` of its `collateral` came back. It leaves the open-position list; pool `idle` and `locked` are now as given. |
| `epoch_processed` | `"epoch_processed"`, `2u32`, `epoch: u32` | `total_assets: i128`<br>`total_shares: i128`<br>`deposit_assets: i128`<br>`deposit_shares: i128`<br>`withdraw_shares: i128`<br>`withdraw_assets: i128`<br>`idle: i128`<br>`total_shares_after: i128` | Epoch `epoch` closed at `total_assets` / `total_shares`: its queued deposits and withdrawals converted at that price (the conversion is also stored as `EpochResult(epoch)`), and epoch `epoch + 1` opened. Pool `idle` and total shares are now `idle` / `total_shares_after`. |

## lp_token

Standard: SEP-41. The approve/transfer/mint/burn events keep the standard SEP-41 layout (no schema-version topic) so wallets and indexers recognize them.

| Event | Topics | Data | State change |
|---|---|---|---|
| `initialized` | `"initialized"`, `2u32` | `pool: address`<br>`decimals: u32`<br>`name: string`<br>`symbol: string` | The share token is live: only `pool` may mint; balances start at zero. |
| `approve` | `"approve"`, `from: address`, `spender: address` | `tuple<i128,u32>` | `spender` may move up to `amount` (data.0) of `from`'s balance until ledger `expiration_ledger` (data.1), replacing any earlier allowance. SEP-41. |
| `transfer` | `"transfer"`, `from: address`, `to: address` | `i128` | `amount` moves from `from` to `to` (also emitted by `transfer_from`, which additionally reduces the spender's allowance). SEP-41. |
| `mint` | `"mint"`, `admin: address`, `to: address` | `i128` | `amount` new shares are created for `to` by the pool (`admin`). SEP-41. |
| `burn` | `"burn"`, `from: address` | `i128` | `amount` of `from`'s shares are destroyed (also emitted by `burn_from`). SEP-41. |

## multisig

Also emits: `schema_migrated`, `migration_progress`, `upgrade_proposed`, `upgrade_cancelled`, `upgraded`, `upgrade_checked`, `upgrade_check_failed`.

| Event | Topics | Data | State change |
|---|---|---|---|
| `initialized` | `"initialized"`, `2u32` | `signers: map<address,u32>`<br>`threshold: u32`<br>`approval_ttl: u64`<br>`rotation_threshold: u32`<br>`rotation_delay: u64`<br>`schema_version: u32` | The multisig is live with these signers and weights, signer-set epoch 0 and no actions. |
| `registered` | `"registered"`, `2u32`, `action_id: bytes32` | `proposer: address`<br>`description_hash: bytes32`<br>`created_at: u64` | Action `action_id` enters the registry as `Pending` (and the pending index) with `description_hash`. Emitted by `register_action`, the first `approve` of an unknown id, `propose` and `propose_signer_change`. |
| `proposal_created` | `"proposal_created"`, `2u32`, `proposal_id: bytes32` | `target: address`<br>`function: symbol`<br>`args: vec<val>`<br>`nonce: u64` | Executor proposal `proposal_id` will call `target.function(args)` as the multisig once approved. Its `registered` event carries `description_hash == proposal_id`. |
| `approved` | `"approved"`, `2u32`, `action_id: bytes32`, `signer: address` | `description_hash: bytes32`<br>`approved_at: u64`<br>`approval_count: u32`<br>`approval_weight: u32`<br>`epoch: u32` | `signer`'s approval of `action_id` is recorded (or refreshed) at `approved_at` in signer-set `epoch`. Fresh approvals now total `approval_count` / `approval_weight`; the action is approved while the weight is at least the threshold, the approvals are fresh and any `execute_by` hasn't passed. |
| `revoked` | `"revoked"`, `2u32`, `action_id: bytes32`, `signer: address` | `description_hash: bytes32`<br>`approval_count: u32`<br>`approval_weight: u32` | `signer` withdrew their approval of `action_id`; fresh approvals now total `approval_count` / `approval_weight`. |
| `reset` | `"reset"`, `2u32`, `action_id: bytes32` | `description_hash: bytes32` | Action `action_id` moves to `Reset` (also for a vetoed signer change): approvals cleared, removed from the pending index. |
| `expired` | `"expired"`, `2u32`, `action_id: bytes32` | `description_hash: bytes32` | Action `action_id` moves to `Expired` because every approval went stale under the approval TTL: approvals cleared, removed from the pending index. |
| `action_expired` | `"action_expired"`, `2u32`, `action_id: bytes32` | `description_hash: bytes32`<br>`execute_by: u64` | Action `action_id` moves to `Expired` because its `execute_by` deadline passed: approvals cleared, removed from the pending index. |
| `executed` | `"executed"`, `2u32`, `action_id: bytes32` | `description_hash: bytes32` | Action `action_id` moves to `Executed` (an executor proposal ran, or a signer change applied): approvals cleared, removed from the pending index. It can never be approved again. |
| `vetoed` | `"vetoed"`, `2u32`, `action_id: bytes32` | `vetoer: address`<br>`description_hash: bytes32` | The vetoer moved action `action_id` to `Vetoed`: approvals cleared, removed from the pending index, never approvable again. |
| `vetoer_set` | `"vetoer_set"`, `2u32` | `vetoer: address` | The one-time vetoer is now `vetoer` (immutable from here on). |
| `execute_by_set` | `"execute_by_set"`, `2u32`, `action_id: bytes32` | `execute_by: u64` | Action `action_id` stops counting as approved after `execute_by` (inclusive). |
| `single_key_quorum` | `"single_key_quorum"`, `2u32`, `signer: address` | `weight: u32`<br>`threshold: u32` | Warning, no state change: `signer`'s `weight` alone meets the approval `threshold` (emitted on initialize and on every rotation). |
| `signer_change_proposed` | `"signer_change_proposed"`, `2u32`, `change_id: bytes32` | `proposer: address`<br>`change: SignerChange` | Signer change `change_id` (`change`) is proposed in signer-set epoch `change.epoch`; it needs the rotation threshold, then `queue_signer_change` and the rotation delay. |
| `signer_change_queued` | `"signer_change_queued"`, `2u32`, `change_id: bytes32` | `ready_at: u64` | Signer change `change_id` reached the rotation threshold; it becomes executable at `ready_at`. |
| `signer_change_vetoed` | `"signer_change_vetoed"`, `2u32`, `change_id: bytes32` | `signer: address` | `signer` killed signer change `change_id`: it moves to `Reset`, its approvals are cleared and it leaves the pending index. |
| `signers_rotated` | `"signers_rotated"`, `2u32`, `change_id: bytes32` | `epoch: u32`<br>`signers: map<address,u32>`<br>`threshold: u32`<br>`rotation_threshold: u32` | Signer change `change_id` applied: the signer set, threshold and rotation threshold are now as given, and the signer-set epoch is `epoch`, which voids every outstanding approval. |
| `upgrade_approved` | `"upgrade_approved"`, `2u32`, `wasm_hash: bytes32` | `signer: address`<br>`approvals: u32`<br>`signer_count: u32` | `signer` consents to upgrading the multisig to `wasm_hash`; `approvals` of `signer_count` signers have. At unanimity the hash is allowlisted (`upgrade_proposed`). |
| `upgrade_revoked` | `"upgrade_revoked"`, `2u32`, `wasm_hash: bytes32` | `signer: address`<br>`approvals: u32` | `signer` withdrew consent to `wasm_hash` (now `approvals`); if it was allowlisted it no longer is (`upgrade_cancelled`). |

## params

Also emits: `schema_migrated`, `migration_progress`.

| Event | Topics | Data | State change |
|---|---|---|---|
| `initialized` | `"initialized"`, `2u32` | `timelock: address`<br>`schema_version: u32` | The registry is live: `timelock` controls it, the registry version is 0 and the schema is `schema_version`. |
| `param_defined` | `"param_defined"`, `2u32`, `key: symbol` | `value: i128`<br>`min: i128`<br>`max: i128`<br>`updated_at: u64`<br>`version: u64` | Creates parameter `key` with `value` inside `[min, max]`. The registry version becomes `version`. |
| `param_updated` | `"param_updated"`, `2u32`, `key: symbol` | `old_value: i128`<br>`new_value: i128`<br>`updated_at: u64`<br>`version: u64` | Parameter `key`'s value changes from `old_value` to `new_value` (bounds unchanged). The registry version becomes `version`. |
| `bounds_proposed` | `"bounds_proposed"`, `2u32`, `key: symbol` | `min: i128`<br>`max: i128`<br>`eta: u64` | Queues new bounds `[min, max]` for `key`, executable from `eta`. Replaces any pending proposal for `key`. |
| `bounds_updated` | `"bounds_updated"`, `2u32`, `key: symbol` | `min: i128`<br>`max: i128`<br>`updated_at: u64`<br>`version: u64` | Parameter `key`'s bounds become `[min, max]` and its pending proposal is cleared. The registry version becomes `version`. |
| `bounds_cancelled` | `"bounds_cancelled"`, `2u32`, `key: symbol` | `min: i128`<br>`max: i128`<br>`eta: u64` | Parameter `key`'s pending bounds proposal (`[min, max]`, due `eta`) is dropped. |

## staking

Also emits: `schema_migrated`, `migration_progress`.

| Event | Topics | Data | State change |
|---|---|---|---|
| `initialized` | `"initialized"`, `2u32` | `stake_token: address`<br>`splitter: address`<br>`cooldown: u64`<br>`schema_version: u32` | Staking is live: `stake_token` is staked, only `splitter` may notify rewards, unstakes wait `cooldown` seconds. |
| `staked` | `"staked"`, `2u32`, `user: address` | `amount: i128`<br>`stake: i128`<br>`total_staked: i128` | `user` staked `amount`; their earning stake is now `stake` and the total `total_staked`. Accrual up to the current accumulator was settled first. |
| `unstake_requested` | `"unstake_requested"`, `2u32`, `user: address` | `amount: i128`<br>`stake: i128`<br>`pending: i128`<br>`unlock_at: u64`<br>`total_staked: i128` | `amount` of `user`'s stake stops earning; their earning stake is now `stake`, their pending unstake `pending`, withdrawable from `unlock_at` (restarted). |
| `withdrawn` | `"withdrawn"`, `2u32`, `user: address` | `amount: i128` | `user`'s whole pending unstake, `amount`, was paid out and cleared. |
| `reward_notified` | `"reward_notified"`, `2u32`, `token: address` | `amount: i128`<br>`reward_per_token: i128`<br>`undistributed: i128`<br>`total_staked: i128` | `amount` of `token` arrived. `RewardPerToken(token)` is now `reward_per_token`; `undistributed` is carried over if nothing was staked. A staker's accrual is `stake × Δreward_per_token / 1e18`. |
| `carryover_distributed` | `"carryover_distributed"`, `2u32`, `token: address` | `amount: i128`<br>`reward_per_token: i128`<br>`total_staked: i128` | Carried-over `token` rewards (`amount`) went to the first stake after an empty pool: `RewardPerToken(token)` is now `reward_per_token` and the carry is zero. |
| `reward_claimed` | `"reward_claimed"`, `2u32`, `user: address`, `token: address` | `amount: i128` | `amount` of `token` accrued to `user` was paid out; their owed balance in `token` is zero. |

## streams

Also emits: `schema_migrated`, `migration_progress`.

| Event | Topics | Data | State change |
|---|---|---|---|
| `initialized` | `"initialized"`, `2u32` | `governance: address`<br>`schema_version: u32` | Streams is live: `governance` may cancel any stream and run migrations. |
| `stream_created` | `"stream_created"`, `2u32`, `stream_id: u64` | `funder: address`<br>`recipient: address`<br>`token: address`<br>`total: i128`<br>`start: u64`<br>`cliff: u64`<br>`end: u64` | Creates stream `stream_id`, funded with `total` of `token` pulled from `funder`, streaming linearly to `recipient` from `start` to `end` with nothing withdrawable before `cliff`. Nothing is withdrawn yet. |
| `withdrawn` | `"withdrawn"`, `2u32`, `stream_id: u64` | `recipient: address`<br>`amount: i128`<br>`withdrawn: i128` | `recipient` withdrew `amount`; the stream's cumulative withdrawn amount is now `withdrawn`. |
| `stream_canceled` | `"stream_canceled"`, `2u32`, `stream_id: u64` | `caller: address`<br>`to_recipient: i128`<br>`to_funder: i128`<br>`streamed: i128` | `caller` cancelled the stream: `to_recipient` went to the recipient and `to_funder` back to the funder. The stream is frozen with total and withdrawn both equal to `streamed`. |
| `stream_transferred` | `"stream_transferred"`, `2u32`, `stream_id: u64` | `from: address`<br>`to: address` | The stream's recipient changes from `from` to `to`, accrued balance included. |
